notes: Wiener Linien 24-hour ticket 10 EUR, 7-day ticket about 25 EUR (48/72-hour tickets discontinued); airport by CAT or S7. The city is walkable; trams 1 and 2 circle the Ring.
Schönbrunn and Belvedere have timed online tickets; standing opera tickets from the box office 80 minutes before (opera closed in summer).
Summer is 26-30°C; Donauinsel, heuriger gardens, the Rathausplatz film festival (free), August is quiet.
Schnitzel 20-25 EUR (Figlmüller), Melange 5 and cake 6 in coffee houses; Sturm at heurigers in autumn. Tip 5-10%.
Shops are closed on Sundays; museums are open.
ÖBB combination ticket for the Wachau; apricot blossom in April, wine harvest September to October.

stops.name: Stephansdom
stops.tips: Cathedral with a colourful tiled roof; the south tower has 343 steps (6 EUR). Quiet in the morning.

stops.name: Graben & Kohlmarkt
stops.tips: The Plague Column and Demel's shop window; imperial streets.

stops.name: Hofburg Sisi Museum
stops.tips: Imperial Apartments, the Sisi Museum and the silver collection; audio guide included.

stops.name: Café Central
stops.tips: Vienna coffee house with columns; Apfelstrudel and Melange (milky coffee), a 15-minute queue.

stops.name: Wiener Staatsoper
stops.tips: The opera is closed in summer; the Rathausplatz Film Festival offers free opera films and food stalls.

backups.name: Albertina
backups.tips: Dürer's Hare and works from Monet to Picasso; an alternative to the Hofburg.

stops.name: Schloss Schönbrunn
stops.tips: The Habsburg summer palace; Imperial Tour 22 EUR online, first slot 08:30, Hall of Mirrors.

stops.name: Schönbrunn Gloriette
stops.tips: Walk up the hill through the gardens; coffee and palace views at the Gloriette café.

stops.name: Schönbrunn Zoo
stops.tips: The world's oldest zoo (1752); pandas.

stops.name: Landtmann's Parkcafé Schönbrunn
stops.tips: Café in the palace park; schnitzel and cake.

stops.name: Naschmarkt
stops.tips: A 1.5 km market; Turkish and Balkan stalls, fish at Umar, flea market on Saturdays.

backups.name: Neni am Naschmarkt
backups.tips: Tel Aviv cuisine; inside the market.

backups.name: Wagenburg Schönbrunn
backups.tips: Museum of imperial carriages; an alternative to the zoo.

stops.name: Oberes Belvedere
stops.tips: Klimt's The Kiss and Schiele; a baroque palace, book online.

stops.name: Belvedere Gardens
stops.tips: Gardens between the palaces; sphinxes.

stops.name: Karlskirche
stops.tips: Baroque dome; take the lift up to fresco level.

stops.name: Figlmüller Wollzeile
stops.tips: Plate-sized pork schnitzel since 1905; book ahead, the Bäckerstrasse branch is quieter.

stops.name: Kunsthistorisches Museum
stops.tips: Bruegel collection, Vermeer, the dome café; Maria-Theresien-Platz.

backups.name: Gasthaus Pöschl
backups.tips: Local schnitzel and tafelspitz (boiled beef); if Figlmüller is full.

backups.name: Secession
backups.tips: Klimt's Beethoven Frieze; the golden cabbage dome.

stops.name: Wiener Riesenrad
stops.tips: Ferris wheel from 1897; The Third Man scene, no queue in the morning.

stops.name: Prater Hauptallee
stops.tips: A 4 km chestnut-lined avenue; cycling and the Lusthaus.

stops.name: Schweizerhaus Prater
stops.tips: Stelze (pork knuckle) and Budweiser; open March to October, beer garden.

stops.name: Donauinsel
stops.tips: Danube island; swimming and cycling in summer, Copa Beach.

stops.name: Hundertwasserhaus
stops.tips: Colourful apartment block with wavy floors; see it from outside, plus the Kunst Haus Wien museum.

backups.name: Lusthaus Prater
backups.tips: Historic pavilion restaurant at the end of the park.

backups.name: Alte Donau Boats
backups.tips: Pedal boats on the Old Danube; an alternative to the island.

stops.name: Melk Abbey
stops.tips: 1 hour by train; baroque abbey and library, views over the Danube. ÖBB Wachau combination ticket (train, boat and abbey).

stops.name: Melk-Krems Danube Boat
stops.tips: 2 hours along the valley; vineyards and castles (Dürnstein).

stops.name: Dürnstein
stops.tips: Town with a blue tower; climb up to Richard the Lionheart's castle.

stops.name: Dürnstein Heuriger
stops.tips: Grüner Veltliner and apricot products at a wine tavern; Wachau apricots.

stops.name: Krems Steiner Tor
stops.tips: Krems old town gate; return train at 17:00.

backups.name: Loibnerhof Unterloiben
backups.tips: A famous Wachau restaurant; next to Dürnstein.

backups.name: Weissenkirchen
backups.tips: Wine village; go by boat instead of Krems.

stops.name: MuseumsQuartier
stops.tips: Leopold Museum (Schiele) and the courtyard seating; mumok.

stops.name: Spittelberg
stops.tips: Biedermeier streets; Christmas market in December.

stops.name: Glacis Beisl Spittelberg
stops.tips: Beisl (Viennese tavern) with a garden behind the MQ; Viennese home cooking.

stops.name: Grinzing Heuriger Mayer am Pfarrplatz
stops.tips: Wine tavern in Beethoven's house; bus 38A, Sturm (young wine) in September and Liptauer (spiced cheese spread).

stops.name: Kahlenberg
stops.tips: View of the city and the Danube from the Vienna Woods; take the 38A, go at sunset.

backups.name: Heuriger Sirbu
backups.tips: Heuriger with views among the Nussberg vineyards; May to October.

backups.name: Karl-Marx-Hof
backups.tips: Red Vienna's 1 km-long housing block; Heiligenstadt.

stops.name: Café Sperl
stops.tips: Coffee house from 1880; billiard tables and newspapers, a farewell breakfast.

stops.name: Mariahilfer Strasse
stops.tips: Shopping street; souvenirs (Manner wafers).

stops.name: Imperial Treasury Vienna
stops.tips: The Habsburg crown and the Holy Lance; Hofburg.

stops.name: Wien Hauptbahnhof CAT
stops.tips: City Airport Train takes 16 minutes (or S7, 30 minutes); farewell.

backups.name: Demel
backups.tips: The Hofburg's pastry shop; Sacher's rival.

backups.name: Haus der Musik
backups.tips: Sound museum; conduct the Philharmonic virtually.
